name: Artillery
description: Complete load testing platform supporting HTTP, GraphQL, WebSocket, Socket.io, gRPC, and Kinesis with serverless distributed execution.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; Docker usage: docker run --rm -it -v ${PWD}:/scripts artilleryio/artillery:2.0.0-30 run /scripts/test_script.yaml

eval_notes: Full-featured load testing platform with YAML scenario definitions. Multi-protocol support including WebSocket and gRPC. Playwright browser testing integration. 20+ monitoring integrations. Well-suited for complex multi-protocol telecom API evaluation.
